content: Indication-specific dosing for the combination of bouncing bet, crow soap, and dog cloves soapwort includes the following details: The recommended dosage is 5 grams taken orally once daily. This combination is indicated for conditions such as bronchitis, cough, and inflammation of the mucous membranes in both the lower and upper respiratory tracts. It is also used for skin conditions such as poison ivy, acne, psoriasis, eczema, and boils. Only the root of the plant is considered applicable for therapeutic use. There is insufficient reliable information currently available regarding its efficacy and safety. Further studies are required to establish more comprehensive data. No adverse effects have been reported in the available literature. However, users should refer to the product label for specific guidance. Potential side effects may include irritation of the stomach, skin, and mucous membranes. Regarding pregnancy and lactation: Pregnancy Category A: No harmful effects are known. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Lactation: No harmful effects are known. This combination is generally considered acceptable for use under the specified conditions.
